This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.

## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noVueDeprecatedSlotAttribute`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Inspired from [`vue/no-deprecated-slot-attribute`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/no-deprecated-slot-attribute)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueDeprecatedSlotAttribute": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow the deprecated `slot` attribute in Vue templates.

Vue 3 removed the `slot` attribute, which Vue 2 used to send content to a
named slot of a component. Vue 3 treats it as a regular attribute, so the
content ends up in the component's default slot instead of the named slot.

Use the `v-slot` directive on a `<template>` element instead, for example
`<template v-slot:header>` or its shorter form `<template #header>`.

The rule checks `slot="..."`, `:slot="..."`, and `v-bind:slot="..."`.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<template>
  <MyComponent>
    <template slot="header">Title</template>
  </MyComponent>
</template>
```

### Valid

```vue
<template>
  <MyComponent>
    <template v-slot:header>Title</template>
  </MyComponent>
  <MyComponent>
    <template #header>Title</template>
  </MyComponent>
  <MyComponent>
    <template #[slotName]>Title</template>
  </MyComponent>
</template>
```

## Options

### `ignore`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `[]`

Names of elements that can use the `slot` attribute. Case and hyphens are
ignored, so `my-component` also matches `MyComponent`.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueDeprecatedSlotAttribute": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"ignore": [
							"my-component"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Valid

```vue
<template>
  <ListComponent>
    <MyComponent slot="header">Title</MyComponent>
  </ListComponent>
</template>
```

#### Invalid

```vue
<template>
  <ListComponent>
    <OtherComponent slot="header">Title</OtherComponent>
  </ListComponent>
</template>
```

### `ignoreParents`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `[]`

Names of elements whose direct children can use the `slot` attribute. Case
and hyphens are ignored, so `my-web-component` also matches `MyWebComponent`.

This is useful for [web components](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_components),
where `slot` is a standard HTML attribute that places a child into a named slot
of the web component.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueDeprecatedSlotAttribute": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"ignoreParents": [
							"my-web-component"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Valid

```vue
<template>
  <my-web-component>
    <span slot="header">Title</span>
  </my-web-component>
</template>
```

#### Invalid

```vue
<template>
  <OtherComponent>
    <span slot="header">Title</span>
  </OtherComponent>
</template>
```
